_provenance.reference: imsg watch.overflow terminal notification, quoted verbatim in https://github.com/steipete/imsg/blob/main/docs/rpc.md ('watch.subscribe' overflow): subscription, resume_after_rowid, reason, terminal.
_provenance.note: Transcribed from published docs, NOT captured from a live Mac. Pins the one payload the channel cannot afford to misparse: the subscription is already dead when this arrives, so a parser that misses resume_after_rowid goes permanently silent rather than losing one message.
